coder_notes: Basket phase 1a/b in BRAF V600 solid tumours (melanoma, NSCLC, primary brain tumours). Glioblastoma is not named in the permitted fields (conditions list Brain Neoplasms, Primary; cohort 5 allows primary brain tumors); the only GBM mention is the RANO outcome text ('glioblastoma participants'), so coded not_glioblastoma and flagged uncertain. Binimetinib is a licensed MEK inhibitor but is a dose-escalated partner in the investigational combination, so both agents are experimental_combination (PF-07284890 is also given alone in Part A). Midazolam is a DDI probe drug, coded supportive.
